name: Incense
author: Erin Carter
description: Two or three hair-thin incense sticks stand at staggered heights in a near-black room, each tipped with a tiny incandescent ember that creeps strictly downward over minutes; dead ash lengthens above it while a thin smoke filament rises and fades, and an occasional spark pops off the glowing cap.

params.label: Burn rate
params.effect: Scales how fast each ember descends its stick.

params.label: Draw pulse
params.effect: Amplitude of the ember's slow brighten-and-bank breathing; 0 holds a steady glow.

params.label: Smoke reach
params.effect: How high in CSS px the smoke filament climbs before fading; 0 removes the smoke.

params.label: Ember size
params.effect: Radius in CSS px of the white-hot tip core.
